_comment: PAPER ONLY copy desk. Jupiter quotes simulate fills. No wallet, no signing, no live order. Thresholds are independent of the main desk config.

safety._comment: Fast checks before a paper copy. Fail closed. Budget is wall-clock seconds.

risk._comment: Hard stop is set at entry from net proceeds and never lowered. Take-profit sells take_profit_fraction at take_profit_net_pct (use 30 to 50). The remainder trails trail_distance_from_peak_pct under the peak. A leader sell of at least leader_sell_fraction of their tokens closes our whole paper position.
